text:
zoe: Posted a small docs PR: "Troubleshooting -> Rate limits & timeouts". Intent: quick debug checklist + small snippets (curl, Go, JS) for inspecting headers and doing polite fallbacks. Need a technical pass and linkcheck.

rahul: Nice. Can we include the `x-rate-limit-reset` header some clients expose? It's been useful for customers to see exact reset times instead of Retry-After.

mei: I'll add a Go example showing header parsing and falling back to a cheaper model if reset > 5s. Also add a note that some proxies rewrite headers so recommend inspecting raw response.

oscar: Suggest adding a short curl one-liner that prints headers so folks can triage quickly. Example: `curl -I -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{}'` and then grep for Retry-After/x-rate-limit-reset.

zoe: Good call. Also add a small checklist at the top: 1) confirm it's a 429 vs client timeout 2) check Retry-After/x-rate-limit-reset 3) consider model fallback 4) trim prefix tokens or use prefix caching 5) verify background load tests.

rahul: For trimming, document recommends dropping oldest tokens first (prefix) and include a token-budget pseudocode. Also note potential UX break if you drop recent messages.

mei: Go snippet I'm adding: `resp.Header.Get("Retry-After")` and `resp.Header.Get("X-Rate-Limit-Reset")`, parse to int, sleep accordingly, or call cheaper model `redwood-medium`. Will push shortly.

oscar: One more: mention streaming behavior differences — 429 during stream can include a final rate-limit frame while 504 commonly results in connection close; add a sentence under "Streaming".

zoe: Added both Go and JS snippets, curl example, a short migration note explaining `retry_policy` -> `backoff_strategy` with an example JSON: `{ "backoff_strategy": { "type": "exponential", "base_ms": 300, "max_ms": 8000, "jitter": true } }`. Also included a small table of common pitfalls (no jitter, base_ms too small, forgetting max_ms).

docs-bot: PR 7601: linkcheck running :hourglass: 

rahul: Quick nit: ensure all code fences specify language and use triple backticks.

mei: Pushed fixes and added a short sentence about proxies rewriting headers.

docs-bot: PR 7601: CI passed :white_check_mark: (docs build + linkcheck)

oscar: LGTM, merging now.

zoe: Merged. I'll follow up with a one-paragraph changelog blurb and a small note in the SDK migration guide to look for `backoff_strategy` examples.
